programs.salaryNote: Median CTC, final placement report 2024-26 (not marked audited). The audited 2023-25 report gives a median MEP of INR 17,03,700.

salarySource.title: IIM Nagpur MBA 2024-2026 Placement Report
salarySource.quote: Median CTC ₹ 16,31,600/- ... 'The median CTC settled at ₹16.32 LPA'. (Not marked as audited; latest audited report is 2023-25: 'Median maximum earning potential: Rs. 17,03,700' https://www.iimnagpur.ac.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Audited-Final-Placement-Report-2023-25.pdf. NIRF 2025 (IR-M-S-15962): 1600000 for graduates of 2023-24.)
